label: Entailment
evidence: Notes and other documents referencing or relating to Confidential Information may be made and kept by the Recipient, but shall continue to be governed by this Confidentiality Agreement until they are destroyed.
reason: Although Section 4 requires return or destruction of Confidential Information, Section 5 expressly allows the Recipient to make and keep notes relating to Confidential Information, which remain governed by the agreement until destroyed, so some Confidential Information may be retained.
